strategy.summary: On PlayMates, soft-plunge the top-center lane to light both 10X lanes, complete two Ace-bank and center-target cycles for Double Bonus, then clear the Aces again and collect a lit 10X side lane for 50,000.

quickInfo.name: Edition split
quickInfo.summary: Domino is the replay edition, and PlayMates is the add-a-ball edition with different scoring on the shared playfield.

quickInfo.name: PlayMates plunge
quickInfo.summary: A soft plunge can collect the top-center lane that lights both 10X lanes, while a full plunge is not recommended.

quickInfo.name: PlayMates roto-target
quickInfo.summary: The PlayMates roto-target scores only 50 points regardless of the numbers shown in its windows.

quickInfo.name: PlayMates Ace cycle
quickInfo.summary: Clear all four Ace drops and shoot the center target twice to earn Double Bonus. Then clear the Aces again and leave them down for the 50,000-point 10X side lanes.

quickInfo.name: PlayMates alternatives
quickInfo.summary: A PlayMates saucer scores 200, and a lit numbered side target also scores 200 when its rebound is safe.

quickInfo.name: Upper exits
quickInfo.summary: A straight exit from the upper playfield can reach a side drain, while a more angled exit is usually safer.

steps.text: Confirm whether the machine is Domino or PlayMates before you use any scoring value.
On PlayMates, soft plunge the top-center lane to light both 10X lanes and do not use a full plunge.
Drop all four Ace targets, then shoot the center target to reset the bank and build bonus.
Clear the four Aces and shoot the center target a second time to earn Double Bonus.
Clear all four Aces again, but do not shoot the center target after this completion.
Send the ball to the upper playfield and collect either lit 10X side lane for 50,000.
Repeat the safer upper feed while avoiding the 50-point roto-target and watching for straight side-drain exits.
On Domino, use the installed instruction card for edition-only roto-target, saucer, and award values.

fallback.title: Safe lit side target
fallback.when: Use this plan on PlayMates when upper exits are unsafe and one lit side target has a tested return.

steps.text: Identify one lit numbered side target.
Shoot it only from a controlled ball.
Prepare both flippers for the target rebound.
Stop after one unsafe rebound and return to top play.

alternatives.title: Natural saucer collect
alternatives.when: Use this plan on PlayMates when the ball approaches a saucer during upper play.

steps.text: Do not replace a safe top shot with a direct saucer shot.
Guide a natural upper-playfield feed toward the saucer.
Collect 200 when the ball enters.
Read the saucer eject and return to top play.
Soft-plunge the top-center lane to light both 10X side lanes.
Complete the Ace bank and center-target reset twice for Double Bonus.
Complete the Ace bank a third time and leave it down.
Return the ball up top and collect a lit 10X side lane for 50,000.

techniques.name: Soft center plunge
techniques.instruction: Use less than full plunge force on PlayMates. Aim for the top-center lane that lights both 10X lanes.

techniques.name: Exit-angle read
techniques.instruction: Watch the line from the upper playfield. Nudge a straight exit before it enters a side-drain path.

techniques.name: Tested side target
techniques.instruction: Shoot a lit numbered target only after an earlier rebound reached a flipper or a return lane.

cautions.issue: The PlayMates roto-target scores only 50 points even when another number appears in its window.
cautions.response: Do not shoot it for points. Use the upper route or a safe lit numbered target.

cautions.issue: A straight upper-playfield exit can travel toward a side drain.
cautions.response: Watch the exit angle and nudge early. Favor upper paths that send the ball downward at a stronger angle.

cautions.issue: A numbered side target can rebound toward danger even when it is lit for 200 on PlayMates.
cautions.response: Test one target at a time. Stop shooting any target that does not return safely.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Domino, Grande Domino, or PlayMates, plus replay versus add-a-ball rules, ball count, tilt, and tournament scoring.
For Domino, read the installed instruction card because scoring can vary by edition.
Test the PlayMates soft plunge, top-center lane, 10X lanes, roto-target, side targets, saucer eject, upper exits, and side-drain feeds.

strategy.overview: Domino and PlayMates use different scoring on the same layout, so the installed edition determines the useful route. On PlayMates, soft-plunge the top-center lane, complete two Ace-bank and center-target cycles for Double Bonus, then clear the Aces again and leave them down. Return up top for a lit 50,000-point 10X side lane while avoiding the low-value roto-target.
